lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into roughly vertical columns containing 4 to 6 local maxima per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of reduced-diameter spots on the dorsal-anterior rostrum, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs posterior to the fifth gill slit.
